## Modules

.claude/ape/ape_hook.py
guideline_checker/__init__.py — guideline-checker: check project compliance against Copilot instruction rules.
guideline_checker/autofix.py — Local, deterministic autofix for violations on rules carrying a ``fix:`` block.
guideline_checker/baseline.py — Baseline support for incremental adoption (L2.2).
guideline_checker/cli.py — CLI entry point for guideline-checker.
guideline_checker/config.py — Project configuration file support (L2.3).
guideline_checker/core/__init__.py
guideline_checker/core/derive/__init__.py — Auto-derivation: turn a rule's prose into a detector without hand-authored YAML.
guideline_checker/core/derive/cache.py — Local ephemeral derived-detector cache (spec §3.4).
guideline_checker/core/derive/seed.py — The seed translator: prose -> a heuristic, in-memory ``RuleDetector``.
guideline_checker/core/detection/__init__.py — Detection orchestrator: run every rule from an :class:`~guideline_checker.loader.InstructionFile`
guideline_checker/core/detection/ast_javascript.py — Precise JavaScript / TypeScript detectors backed by tree-sitter.
guideline_checker/core/detection/ast_python.py — Precise Python detectors backed by the standard-library :mod:`ast`.
guideline_checker/core/detection/crossref.py — The cross-reference mechanism: a name cited in one file must have a
guideline_checker/core/detection/kinds.py — The MECHANISMS taxonomy — a finite set of generic *check kinds* (ADR D-0020).
guideline_checker/core/detection/numeric.py — Measurement primitives for the ``numeric-threshold`` mechanism (ADR D-0021).
guideline_checker/core/detection/pattern.py — Pattern-derived checks: substring/regex matching against source lines and
guideline_checker/core/detection/presence.py — Whole-file presence/absence checks: a rule's declarative detector fan-out,
guideline_checker/core/detection/scanner_source.py — File-access abstraction shared by the distribution audit.
guideline_checker/core/detection/scanners.py — Named, language-agnostic content scanners for declarative ``detect.scan`` checks.
guideline_checker/core/health.py — Deterministic rule-health engine.
guideline_checker/fixers.py — Remediation producers + PR planner for distribution drift.
guideline_checker/fleet/__init__.py
guideline_checker/fleet/distribution.py — Origin-side distribution-compliance checks.
guideline_checker/fleet/gh_client.py — Thin wrapper over the ``gh`` CLI — the single mock seam for origin-side reads/writes.
guideline_checker/fleet/lifecycle.py — Repository lifecycle checks — is this repo alive, and what does it drag along?
guideline_checker/fleet/manifest.py — Load the chrysa fleet manifest (``repos.yml``) into audit targets.
guideline_checker/fleet/origin_audit.py — Drive the distribution audit across a fleet manifest, origin-side.
guideline_checker/guidelines.py — Load the structured multi-dimension YAML rule referential (``guidelines/``).
guideline_checker/hook.py — Pre-commit hook entry point for guideline-checker.
guideline_checker/init_cmd.py — Init command: scaffold default instruction files in a project.
guideline_checker/linters.py — External linter integration: ruff, mypy, eslint/biome.
guideline_checker/loader.py — Load and parse instruction/guideline files from multiple sources.
guideline_checker/reporters/__init__.py
guideline_checker/reporters/html.py — HTML report generator for guideline-checker results.
guideline_checker/reporters/json_reporter.py — JSON report generator for guideline-checker results (CI artifact).
guideline_checker/reporters/markdown.py — Markdown report generator for guideline-checker results.
guideline_checker/reporters/sarif.py — SARIF 2.1.0 report generator for guideline-checker.
guideline_checker/reporters/synthesis_html.py — Multi-repo synthesis HTML reporter.
guideline_checker/web/__init__.py — Web dashboard for guideline-checker.
